title: EDL review page (kept vs cut, side by side)
what_it_does: Builds one HTML page with a timeline showing kept (green) and removed (red) parts, the biggest cuts listed, and the original and edited videos side by side so each cut can be heard.
when_to_use: After automatic silence or mistake cutting, to let the person approve it.
why: MIT, self-contained HTML; it makes automatic cutting trustworthy because the person can hear what was removed.
